name: @kai/core
description: KAI Core — control-plane service bridging the KAI desktop app (Tauri) to the Hermes Agent api-server and the OpenCode headless server.

scripts.//bundle: Builds the shipped Core into core/bundle: no test files, plus the package.json that makes it ESM where there is no core/ package.json (an installed app).
scripts.//test: Runs every *.test.ts under core/tests and core/src straight from TypeScript (Node 26 strips types). scripts/test.mjs discovers the files itself - npm runs scripts through cmd.exe on Windows, which does not expand globs - and loads API_SERVER_KEY from the Hermes install for the live-auth suites without printing it. --with-dist also runs compiled tests.
scripts.//build: Compiles, then stamps dist/build-info.json with a content-derived build id (see scripts/build-info.mjs). Identity must be rebuilt with the code or it lies.
